item.title: Public Encouraged To Take Action During Cervical Cancer Prevention Week
item.description: This week is Cervical Cancer Prevention Week, a national and international campaign highlighting how cervical cancer can be prevented through HPV vaccination, regular screening and early awareness of symptoms. In Ireland, around 250 women are diagnosed with cervical cancer each year, despite the fact that most cases are linked to HPV and are largely preventable.
